spec_match.rationale: Asks the three real support APIs about six IAMF strings spanning profiles and inner codecs plus three controls — exactly the chromestatus contract (IAMF decode exposed through MSE/media elements).

interactive.rationale: Probe-again button re-runs the full matrix; the banner, per-row verdicts and disagreement analysis are generated from live API answers (re-click verified; output identical because the answers are stable, and the button disables while running).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb says the three APIs answer the same question differently and the page shows precisely that, including the three-state canPlayType column.

edge_cases.rationale: Positive controls (opus, AAC-LC), a negative control (notacodec) that must be rejected for the run to be trusted, and an explicit distrust message when a control misbehaves.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus and AOMedia spec links present.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite runs 6/6 pass here and its assertions mirror the same contracts the matrix exercises, including the probe-integrity control.

runtime_evidence.rationale: On this Chromium 153 build the banner reads 'IAMF decodes here' with 6 of 6 IAMF strings supported and the invented codec correctly rejected — real positive runtime evidence, console and network clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: codec-matrix-probed asserts controlsWork, which is falsifiable (fails if a control codec stops probing as supported).

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, verdict colours on near-white backgrounds, table in a scroller.

accessibility.rationale: Single button with clear name, outputs aria-live, italicised control rows also explained in prose, visible focus on all 12 tab stops.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow on mobile; wide tables scroll inside .scroller containers rather than stretching the page.

openQuestions.title: Refresh the feature index 'enabling it now' copy — IAMF decodes on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: The feature index still says 'Not available on the Chrome 150 used to build these pages' with every IAMF string returning unsupported. Measured on Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (this milestone's own build), all six IAMF strings probe as supported across the three APIs and the conformance suite passes 6/6, so the index section now understates reality. Update the copy to record the measured 153 result (keep the 150 measurement as history).

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. The matrix shows the real shipped state on Chromium 153 — 6/6 IAMF strings supported, controls behave, negative control rejected — making this one of the few pages whose success path is fully observable in this environment. The feature index's 'enabling it now' section is now stale and should record the 153 measurement.
